_comment: T-333: honest per-character named-blue odds; guaranteed greens remain repeatable.

mob_pallbearer_ost._comment: T-719 tutorial capstone, boss 1. Guaranteed uncommon, NO gated drop — a first-timer's first boss must never end in nothing, and the one lottery in the run belongs to the finale below.

mob_sexton_marrow._comment: T-719 tutorial capstone, boss 2 (the climax). Guaranteed uncommon so the run always pays, plus a 0.12 per-character named-rare — the 'reason to come back' the campaign asks for lives in a drop that is deliberately NOT guaranteed.

mob_vault_sentinel._comment: T-473 Era-1 raid tier (Vault of the First Hollowing). cadence=weekly re-locks the gated drop to the ISO week; the pool is EPIC and rolls ONCE per kill for the whole raid (round_robin via the T-472 loot_rule seam), so 0.40 is a per-KILL chance, not per-member like the crypt's per-person 0.14-0.18.
